name: the quiet boundary becomes exclusive: a builder quiet for exactly the window is not reported
expect: a builder quiet for 10 minutes wakes the orchestrator at minute 10, exit 1, named QUIET

name: the window is no longer counted from arming
expect: a worktree already quiet for a day gets a full window from arming

name: the poll interval doubles
expect: every wait between polls is 60 s

name: a quiet builder exits 0
expect: a builder quiet for 10 minutes wakes the orchestrator at minute 10, exit 1, named QUIET

name: CANNOT RUN exits 1, like a quiet builder
expect: a worktree missing at arming is CANNOT RUN at once: exit 2, no poll, the builder named
a worktree removed at minute 3 is CANNOT RUN at that poll, and the other is listed active
a quiet builder and an unreadable one in the same poll are BOTH reported, exit 2

name: an unwatchable builder is skipped in silence
expect: a worktree missing at arming is CANNOT RUN at once: exit 2, no poll, the builder named
a worktree removed at minute 3 is CANNOT RUN at that poll, and the other is listed active

name: only the first quiet builder is recorded
expect: two builders quiet in the same poll are BOTH reported, and there is nothing to re-arm

name: only the first builder is examined
expect: two builders, the SECOND quiet: it is reported, the first is listed active with its re-arm command

name: the worktree's files are not read
expect: activity: a file deep in the worktree counts
a file written at minute 4 restarts the window: woken at minute 14

name: a directory's own time is not read
expect: activity: a directory's own time counts (a delete shows only there)
activity: the worktree root's own time counts

name: node_modules is walked
expect: activity: node_modules and .next, at any depth, do not count

name: .next is walked
expect: activity: node_modules and .next, at any depth, do not count

name: a .git directory is walked
expect: activity: a .git directory's objects do not count, only its HEAD, index and logs/HEAD

name: the git index is not read
expect: activity: the git HEAD, index and logs/HEAD each count
git activity alone (the index, minute 4) restarts the window

name: the git logs/HEAD is not read
expect: activity: the git HEAD, index and logs/HEAD each count
a main-checkout-shaped worktree (.git directory) is watched the same way

        os.stat(os.path.join(gd, GIT_REQUIRED))
        best = 0.0

edits:
raise CannotRun(f"the git directory {gd} is unreadable ({exc})") from None
        best = 0.0
expect: CANNOT RUN: a git directory with no HEAD
a quiet builder and an unreadable one in the same poll are BOTH reported, exit 2

edits:
if w.transcript is not None:

a builder that only READS: transcript activity at minute 4 restarts the window when it is given, and is invisible when it is not
CANNOT RUN: a transcript that does not exist

name: a missing transcript is tolerated
edits:
raise CannotRun(f"the transcript {w.transcript} is unreadable ({exc})") from None
            pass
expect: CANNOT RUN: a transcript that does not exist

edits:
raise CannotRun(f"the worktree {w.worktree} is missing")
        return 0.0
expect: CANNOT RUN: a worktree that does not exist
a worktree missing at arming is CANNOT RUN at once: exit 2, no poll, the builder named
a worktree removed at minute 3 is CANNOT RUN at that poll, and the other is listed active

name: the silent-call floor is dropped

name: the silent-call floor becomes exclusive: exactly 270 s is accepted
expect: arguments: a window of exactly 270 s is refused, one silent legal call would trip it

name: the silent-call bound drifts from the long-call guard's
expect: the silent-call bound equals check-agent-long-call's LIMIT_S

expect: arguments: a QUIET_MIN with no pair is CANNOT RUN
